content.text:
EP3477840B1 (University of Maribor, "Welding transformer") is cited by two documents, both from Robert Bosch and both belonging to the same invention. In each case the citation was added by the examiner during search, not by the applicant.

| Citing publication | Applicant | Published | Origin |
|---|---|---|---|
| EP3796345A1 | Robert Bosch GmbH | 2021-03-24 | Examiner search report (SEA) |
| CN112530684A | Robert Bosch (China filing) | 2021-03-19 | Examiner search report (SEA) |

Both citing documents share the title "Welding transformer, method for producing a module for a welding transformer and method for producing a welding transformer" and are two members of one Bosch family. So in practice there is one citing invention, found by examiners at both the EPO and the CNIPA as relevant prior art.

Context on the cited patent:
- Filed 2018-10-25 at the EPO, granted 2020-05-27, claiming Slovenian priority SI201700288 from 2017-10-26. The family also includes SI25535A and the Slovenian validation SI3477840T1.
- Its own search report cites nine patents. Five came from the examiner (including JP2011212690A, EP2056439A2, EP1976104A2, EP1760867A2, DE4302443C1) and four from the applicant.
- No non-patent literature is cited in either direction.

Data source is PATSTAT 2026 Spring, so any citations from documents published after that edition's cutoff would not yet appear.
